notice: 75 compositions in GitHub feature branch. 24 original Dark Antey MP3 files validated by SHA-256. Author CC BY 4.0 notice and inconsistent Bandcamp footer disclosed in credits. Live site playback and access from Russia require independent testing.
metadataNote: No 20-track cap. Dark Antey tempo estimates are tentative, particularly on ambient pieces. Two tracks from Deep Russian Depression remain missing from the user's supplied uploads.
